lowering.scope: This experiment moves the call before the common fallback and can split merged scan-entry blocks. Whole ordinary text identity is not its gate. Preserve all original constant bytes and both canonical fallback owners, and report every compiler and linked layout change before timing.

linked_layout.criterion: Preserve original constant bytes and canonical fallback owners; retain all scan-entry lowering and linked symbol movements for actual throughput qualification.
